elaine: opened PR #842 for the migration guide + SDK examples. preview: https://deploy-preview-842--docs.redwood.com

sam: thanks — skimmed. two quick notes: the python snippet needs a params dict instead of positional args, and there's an extra leading space on the H2.

CI-bot: CI status: docs-preview failed 
- markdownlint: MD009 (trailing spaces) on docs/migrate/v2.md: line 42
- link-checker: broken link to /sdk/python (404) in docs/reference/index.md: line 12
- vale: PRV002 Passive voice in docs/migrate/v2.md: line 88

nora: I can take the broken link. looks like the SDK python guide got renamed to /sdk/python-sdk; quick fix is to update the relative path.

jen: markdownlint also flagged header increment (H2->H4) in the migration examples. small structural change.

sam: can we hold merge until CI is green? I'll push a patch later today. want to avoid rolling bad content into release.

elaine: agreed. plan: 
1) nora updates link to /sdk/python-sdk and adds a redirect note in the frontmatter
2) jen fixes header levels and trims trailing spaces (quick regex)
3) sam will run vale locally and fix the passive phrasing or justify with a comment if it's a deliberate phrasing.

nora: done — pushed commit 7f2a1d3. changed link and added note: ``redirect_from: /sdk/python``

jen: pushed commit 9c3b4ea — header levels fixed, removed trailing spaces. used `npm run docs:lint` locally and it passed.

sam: running vale now: `vale --config .vale.ini docs/migrate/v2.md`
vale: flagged 'was updated' as passive, suggested 'updated'. I swapped wording on the two sentences and pushed commit b4d5c2f.

CI-bot: re-run requested by @sam
CI-bot: rebuild queued (docs-preview)

CI-bot: docs-preview build: in progress — deploying preview site

CI-bot: docs-preview build: success ✅ 
Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-842--docs.redwood.com
Link-check: passed
markdownlint: passed
vale: passed

sam: looks green on preview, spot-checked the python snippet and redirect. LGTM from my side.

elaine: thanks everyone. I'll merge during the quiet window tomorrow at 09:00 PT to avoid docs site churn during peak support hours.

jen: can you add a short changelog bullet in the PR description noting the redirect and wording changes? Helps for release notes.

elaine: added changelog line and a short note about the vale rule justification. merging now. :tada:

CI-bot: PR #842 merged by elaine (Docs) at 1717594756

sam: nice, thanks for the quick turnaround! :thumbsup:

nora: cool — I'll follow up with a small unit test to catch the rename next time.

jen: great teamwork :)

CI-bot: reminder: if you hit link renames often consider adding a redirect entry in docs/_redirects or update the link-check whitelist.
